organization type from NTEE code and 501(c) subsection

Source: R/09-org-type.R
org_type_from_codes.Rd

Maps the IRS Business Master File's NTEE code and 501(c) subsection (for example from the NCCS unified BMF, panel990::bmf_retrieve()) to an org_type_levels() type, or NA.

Usage

org_type_from_codes(ntee, subsection, name = "")

Arguments

ntee

NTEE code (e.g. "X21", "M24"); NA or "UNDEFINED" when unknown.

subsection

501(c) subsection number (e.g. 3, 5, 19).

name

Organization name, used only to keep a university's foundation, alumni or student association out of "university".

Value

A character vector of types, NA where none applies.
